title: Yak time
text: **Grace’s corner** we stumbled across the cutest herd of yaks while hiking. They were sunbathing, splashing a deep puddle and licking their calfs. Rushan and Thrall got a bit too close to a calf and the mother then charged at them (please see the last photo where Thrall ran onto the rock to escape). Daniel also really wanted to pat the brown calf pictured but I’m glad he didn’t (I don’t know if his travel insurance would cover him).
